instruction:
Remove Ideal Loads In Four-Space Init Model. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input files init.osm and weather.epw. Use init_plan.png on the Desktop as the visual reference for the target layout. Modify the model rather than replacing the task package with an unrelated file. Save result.osm in the task output folder.

Create 1 building story, 4 spaces and 4 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: V13-Space-1, V13-Space-2, V13-Space-3 and V13-Space-4. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area.

Model the enclosure with 24 total OS:Surface objects, split into 4 floor surfaces, 4 roof/ceiling surfaces and 16 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 4 Ground, 14 Outdoors and 6 Surface.

Add 8 OS:SubSurface objects, all of them FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 35.84 m2 within +/-0.50 m2.

Do not include ideal-loads air systems. Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 4 zone HVAC equipment lists and 4 dual-setpoint thermostats.

Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 28.00 m in X, 9.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 252.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 236.80 m2 within +/-0.50 m2.

Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
